entities.name: Henry Leppä
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Henry Erik Leppä was a Finnish professional ice hockey player who played in the SM-liiga. He played for Jokerit and TuTo. He was inducted into the Finnish Hockey Hall of Fame in 1996. Leppä was born in Turku, Finland on 12 March 1947, and died on 2 June 2025, at the age of 78.
